findings.summary: If purge_job runs on a different thread than request handlers, revoke and purge_expired update _by_token and _items in opposite order without a lock, so a concurrent logout and purge can cause KeyError in purge_expired (aborting the sweep) and ValueError in revoke (500 instead of 204).

judge.reason: Describes the known no-locking race issue, which counts as a known real problem.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: The backward index deletion loop in purge_expired (and list.remove in revoke) is O(n²) in the worst case; a list comprehension rebuild would be simpler.

judge.reason: The O(n) list.remove in revoke is a known problem. The backward-deletion part is correct per ok1, and the finding is mostly a performance and style point.

findings.label: valid_other
